0.0: #b#h0##k! I knew you would be back. Like I said, I'll give you another gift if you collect another #b1200 Family Points#k! That's means you only have to collect #r200#k more! Easy right? What do you say?

yes.0: Good! Return to me after you collect #b1200 Family Points#k. \nHappy New Year, and good luck!

no.0: That's too bad. Think of all the friends you could make!

1.0: How'd it go? Did you send greetings to even more Maplers? Wow, you've collected #b1200 Family Points#k already. Maple World is a much brighter place thanks to you!

yes.0: Here's your gift! Thank you for greeting all those families today! I'll have another gift for you if you #esend greetings to new families tomorrow#n. Be sure to stop by!

default.0: You haven't greeted enough Maple families yet. You get 100 Family Points every time your greeting is accepted, and 20 Maple Points for every greeting you accept. Try harder! Remember, you need #b1200 Family Points#k!
